Riverbend County Health Coverage Office
220 Front Street
Riverbend, Pennsylvania 17000

NOTICE OF ACTION
Notice Date: October 26, 2026
Case Number: 55-0193-7741

Dear Dana R.,

Your Medical Assistance (Medicaid) coverage will end on November 30, 2026.

Reason: We did not receive the information needed to complete your renewal.

If you think we made a mistake, you have the right to ask for a fair hearing. You must ask for a hearing within 90 days of the date of this notice.

If you ask for a hearing within 10 days of the date of this notice, your benefits may continue until a decision is made.

To ask for a hearing, call 1-800-555-0142 or write to the address above.

This notice does not affect other household members.

reply:
[DATE]

To: [NAME OF AGENCY CONTACT]
Re: Request for fair hearing and continued coverage — Case [CASE NUMBER]

My name is [YOUR NAME]. I received the agency's notice dated October 26, 2026 about my Medicaid coverage.

The notice states: "Your Medical Assistance (Medicaid) coverage will end on November 30, 2026."

I disagree with this action and I am requesting a fair hearing.
I am requesting that my coverage continue while the hearing is pending, as provided in 42 CFR 431.230(a).
I am sending this request before Thursday, November 5, 2026.

The notice does not fully include information that federal rules require it to contain. Please provide, in writing:
  • the specific regulations that support the action, or the change in law that requires it (42 CFR 431.210(c))
  • a clear statement of the specific reasons supporting the intended action (42 CFR 431.210(b)) — the notice addresses this only in part
  • an explanation of my right to request a hearing (42 CFR 431.210(d)) — the notice addresses this only in part

Please confirm receipt of this request in writing. You can reach me at [YOUR PHONE OR EMAIL].

Sincerely,
[YOUR NAME]
